summary: EuroDry Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing an Equity Distribution Agreement dated September 11, 2026 with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners as sales agent for an at-the-market offering of up to $20,000,000 of common shares, par value $0.01, including attached preferred stock purchase rights under the May 5, 2018 Rights Agreement, as amended. The shares are issued under a Form F-3 (File No. 333-298606) declared effective September 3, 2026, with a prospectus supplement dated September 11, 2026 and a Seward & Kissel validity opinion as Exhibit 5.1. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch the pace of ATM sales and any dilution or rights-plan overhang.
